final_sql:
```sql
SELECT 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)]
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.NCESSchool = schools.NCESSchool
WHERE 
    schools.AgeGroup = '5-17'
ORDER BY 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)] ASC
LIMIT 3;
```
